page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by 24 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 93.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. The server includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU from the Turing architecture family with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, ranking in the bottom 10% to 25% in stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, multi-core performance is average, utilizing the 24 dedicated cores effectively. Memory bandwidth is average for large block reads but shows weaker performance in Passmark memory scores. The integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong results for AI workloads, achieving top-tier performance in LLM prompt processing for both 135M and 7B models, and strong performance in 7B model text generation.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this server offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads without the high cost of top-tier accelerators. The lack of local storage requires external storage provisioning, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is highly suited for low-to-medium complexity deep learning inference, LLM prompt processing, and parallel computing tasks that leverage GPU acceleration, while being less optimal for single-threaded CPU-bound applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.6xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server featuring 24 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz, 93.0 GB of RAM, and a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM, this instance does not include local storage and provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data indicates weak single-core CPU performance, but average multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities. The server excels in GPU-driven tasks, achieving top-tier results in LLM prompt processing for small and medium models. This hardware profile represents a cost-effective option for parallel processing and machine learning inference. It is best suited for workloads such as AI inference, moderate deep learning tasks, and parallel compute applications, though it is less effective for single-threaded CPU operations.
